title: test(scripts): cite the bare-ValidationRule negatives by file, not by line; mark the two retired names synthetic (objectui#10781)
body:
Fixes #10781

Clause-②: no. It is a test-fixture citation, and nothing published moves.

## What changed

One file, `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts`, comments only. With comments masked, the test's code is byte-identical to `origin/main` (measured below).

- The negative fixtures of the bare-`ValidationRule` matcher (test "the bare-`ValidationRule` match discriminates every near-spelling that really exists") no longer carry line addresses.
  - `AdvancedValidationRule` and `ValidationRuleType`: objectui#10719 (PR objectui#10759) retired both names. No live spelling puts a suffixed name on the `type … =` branch, so there is nothing truthful to re-cite `ValidationRuleType` to, and route 1 of the card has no live pair. Both stay as **SYNTHETIC** negatives (route 2). The comment above them says so, gives the reason each shape is kept, and points at the retirement pin `phase35-validation-types-retired-10719.test.ts` in `packages/types`.
  - `ObjectValidationRule`, `DesignerValidationRule`, `FieldValidationRules`, `ValidationRuleDraft` and `BaseValidationRuleShape` are re-cited by the file they live in, with no line. AGENTS.md #11 and the citation gate's own header both say an address is repaired by turning it into a content anchor, not by moving the number.
  - The block comment no longer says every negative is a spelling this repository writes. That is only true of the negatives with a file beside them; the rest are shapes. It also states that nothing re-derives either kind of citation (AGENTS.md #9).
- The same file has one other stale cross-file address, in the objectui#5106 key-table block: the `plugin-grid.mdx` specimen of a "none — `skipFallback: true`" row. It now points at the `view:grid` row by content. Acceptance notes say why it is in this PR.

## Why this is wider than the card's Finding

The card's Finding names two addresses. Its Acceptance reads: "No fixture in that file cites a `packages/types/src/**` address that does not hold the cited spelling at head." Measured at `origin/main` `bf14b6460`, **none** of the six addresses into `packages/types/src` held its spelling:

- objectui#10759 removed the two lines the Finding names.
- The other four were wrong before that. They cite `data-protocol.ts` (twice, including the `BaseValidationRuleShape` quote), `designer.ts` and `form.ts`, and each already pointed at an unrelated line on `97b6c21^`, the tree before objectui#10759.

Changing only two would leave the Acceptance false. The seventh fixture address, app-shell `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`, still held; it is converted anyway so the list uses one citation form.

## Evidence (head `a90af71878`)

| Check | Reading |
|---|---|
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` (under `os-verify-lock`) | `Tests 125 passed (125)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| Masked-code equality against `bf14b6460`: `stripComments` from `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`, with blank lines and trailing spaces dropped | equal. Positive control: dropping one negative fixture from the base reads unequal |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s), enforcement report-only -> exit 0` |
| `node scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs --json`, rows whose citing file is this test | 7 before, 0 after. ⚠️ This is **not** a census reading: the census exits 1 on `bf14b6460` as well, because one of its own controls fails there (see Acceptance notes) |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | OK, exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | "no changeset is owed", exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm check:spec-symbols`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:doc-types`, `pnpm check:comment-mask-corpus`, `pnpm check:shell-escape-residue` | exit 0 each |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts`. This test is in its file list, counted with `tsc --listFilesOnly` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the touched file | 1 file linted, 0 errors, 0 warnings |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the touched path | NOT GOVERNED |
| Adjacent tests: `markdown-test-inputs`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`, `cross-file-line-citation-census` | 3 files, 132 passed |

Not run locally:

- The `@object-ui/types` type-check and its consumer packages. No package file moves, so the contract-face lane rule does not apply.
- Full `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint`. Those belong to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Acceptance ①.** No line address is left in the fixture list. Every file named beside a live negative declares or quotes that spelling at head: `export type ObjectValidationRule =`, `export interface DesignerValidationRule {`, `export interface FieldValidationRules {`, `interface ValidationRuleDraft {`, and the `ConditionalValidation` docblock, which names `BaseValidationRuleShape`. This was checked by hand. Nothing re-derives it, and the comment says so.
- **Acceptance ②.** The fixture strings are unchanged byte for byte, and the matcher's negative cases pass.
- **Acceptance ③.** No changeset: `check-changeset-presence` owes none.
- **Scope beyond the claim's locus.** The claim's file surface is this one file, and nothing outside it is touched. The claim names "the two fixtures and their comment" as the locus. This PR also edits:
  - the other five fixture citations in the same list, which the card's own Acceptance requires;
  - the one stale address in the objectui#5106 block. AGENTS.md #11 says "When you touch a file anyway, fix the cross-file line addresses inside it". It is the same defect class and a mechanical content-anchor conversion, in the same gate family, and no other claim or open PR holds the file.
- **Remaining `path:line`-shaped strings in this file** are expected `site` values of synthetic fixture pages, which the gate under test computes. They are not citations.
- **Observation, not filed.** `node scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` exits 1 on `origin/main` `bf14b6460` and prints "this run is NOT a reading". Its `non-firing` control, the `getJsxManifest` citation from `layout-containers-declare-containment.test.tsx` into `renderers/layout/page.tsx`, now scores `drifted`. It is a report-only tool behind no public door. Carrier: none named.
- **Premise.** The Finding holds for its two addresses. It under-reads the population its own Acceptance covers: four more addresses were already stale before objectui#10759.
